1.bug_scenario: The bug report describes an accessibility issue with the dropdown component in the Carbon Design System. When the dropdown list is open, the IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker reports a violation indicating that none of the descendent elements with the 'option' role are tabbable. This issue occurs in both V10 and V11 versions of the carbon components, specifically in the Firefox browser on MacOS. The problem is demonstrated in the attached screenshots, showing the accessibility checker tool highlighting the violation.
